ModMetaData.name: SadSeal's Work Manager
ModMetaData.author: SadSeal5 / Ramo
ModMetaData.description:
SadSeal's Work Manager is a high-performance, lightweight, automated work priority and colonist schedule manager engineered for RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (.NET 10).
Features: - Automated Work Priorities: Intelligently evaluates colonist skill levels, burning and minor passions, physical health capacities, and traits to dynamically assign manual 1-4 priorities. - Emergency Work Protection: Always guarantees Firefighting, Patient, Bed Rest, and Basic tasks are prioritized. - Dedicated Specialist Assignment: Assigns optimal specialist quotas for Doctors, Cooks, Researchers, Wardens, and Handlers. - Automated 24-Hour Scheduling: Distributes colonist timetables into balanced sleep, recreation, and work periods. - Dedicated Night Owl Support: Nocturnal colonists automatically receive inverted night shifts for permanent mood bonuses. - Idle Colonist Redirection: Idle pawns automatically receive temporary Hauling and Cleaning priorities to keep the colony spotless. - Zero TPS Overhead: Highly optimized architecture with zero per-tick allocations. - Full English and Turkish (Türkçe) localization.
